columns.comment: Calendar date of the deal signing. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the deal signing as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the deal signing, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the deal signing).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Facility type priced - Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility, Bilateral Loan, Syndicated Loan, Overdraft or Trade Loan.
columns.name: Product

columns.comment: True when the deal was approved with an origination RAROC below the 12% hurdle (a pricing exception).
columns.name: Approved Below Hurdle

columns.comment: Reason for approving below hurdle - Relationship, Strategic Client, Cross-sell Commitment or Competitive Pricing; blank without exception.
columns.name: Exception Reason

columns.comment: Caught up / Still below hurdle (deals approved below hurdle), Held above hurdle / Slipped below hurdle (deals approved at or above), Not yet seasoned (signed after Mar-2026).
columns.name: Realised Status

columns.comment: Priced margin vs the margin the deal needs for the RoRWA hurdle - Above hurdle (>= +25 bps), At hurdle, Below hurdle (< -25 bps).
columns.name: Pricing Status

columns.comment: True for deals signed in the last four fiscal quarters to 30-Sep-2026 (FY2025-Q3 to FY2026-Q2).
columns.name: Signed in Last 4 Quarters

columns.comment: True for deals signed in the last four quarters that already have a realised RAROC (FY2025 - Apr-2025 to Mar-2026).
columns.name: Signed in Last 4 Seasoned Quarters

columns.comment: Credit deals signed in the selected period.
columns.name: Deals

columns.comment: Deal (facility limit) amount in USD.
columns.name: Amount USD

columns.comment: Average RAROC at origination incl. the client's ancillary revenue (fraction, winsorised -25%..100%).
columns.name: Average Origination RAROC %

columns.comment: Average realised RAROC of the seasoned deals (fraction, winsorised).
columns.name: Average Realised RAROC %

columns.comment: Deals approved with an origination RAROC below the 12% hurdle.
columns.name: Below-Hurdle Deals

columns.comment: Deals approved below hurdle / deals (fraction).
columns.name: Below-Hurdle Deals %

columns.comment: Deals with a realised RAROC (signed up to Mar-2026).
columns.name: Seasoned Deals

columns.comment: Deals approved below hurdle whose realised RAROC is back at or above the 12% hurdle.
columns.name: Deals Caught Up

columns.comment: Below-hurdle deals that caught up / seasoned below-hurdle deals (fraction).
columns.name: Caught-Up Rate %

columns.comment: Average realised minus origination RAROC of the seasoned deals (fraction; negative = slipped).
columns.name: RAROC Slippage pts

columns.comment: Average priced margin minus the margin needed for the RoRWA hurdle, in basis points (negative = underpriced).
columns.name: Average Margin Gap bps

columns.comment: Average margin priced on the drawn amount, in basis points.
columns.name: Average Priced Margin bps

columns.comment: The configured RAROC hurdle from gold.dim_threshold (RAROC_HURDLE, 0.12 = 12%).
columns.name: RAROC Hurdle %

comment: Deal pricing discipline of SMBC APAC credit deals signed Apr-2023 to Sep-2026 (USD): deals, amount, origination RAROC vs the 12% hurdle (gold.dim_threshold), deals approved below hurdle and the exception reason (Relationship, Strategic Client, Cross-sell Commitment, Competitive Pricing), realised RAROC once seasoned (deals signed up to Mar-2026), whether it caught up with the hurdle, RAROC slippage and the priced margin vs the margin needed. Calendar fields are of the SIGNING date (Signing Quarter = Fiscal Quarter). "Last 4 quarters" = Oct-2025..Sep-2026 (FY2026 deals not yet seasoned); "did realised RAROC catch up" questions use the last 4 seasoned quarters = FY2025. Grain: one row per credit deal (facility) signed from FY2023 (gold.fact_deal_pricing).
